data.name: Great Sand Dunes Visitor Center
data.description: The visitor center offers restrooms, a water fill station, interactive exhibits, and a 20-minute video about the park. Park rangers are available to answer questions and help you plan your time.
data.audioDescription: The visitor center offers restrooms, a water fill station, interactive exhibits, and a 20-minute video about the park. Park rangers are available to answer questions and help you plan your time.
data.passportStampLocationDescription: Great Sand Dunes National Park and Preserve passport cancellation stamp available during visitor center hours.

emailAddresses.description: Please leave a message with your name and full phone number if you would like a call back or address if you would like information mailed to you. May take 24 hours to receive a reply.

data.directionsInfo: From CO Highway 160: Between the towns of Alamosa, CO, and Blanca, CO, there will be large brown signs marking the turn off to the park. Turn north on CO State Highway 150. Drive straight (north) for 15 miles to the entrance of the park. From CO Highway 17: Near the town of Mosca, CO, turn onto County Road Lane 6N. At the end of the road, turn left (north) onto CO State Highway 150. This highway will take you into the national park.

operatingHours.description: Current visitor center hours are 9-4:30 daily throughout the year. Open every day except Thanksgiving, Christmas, and New Year's Day.
operatingHours.name: Great Sand Dunes Visitor Center

data.name: Entrance Station
data.description: Purchase park passes at the Entrance Station, located on the main entrance road.
data.audioDescription: Purchase park passes at the Entrance Station, located on the main entrance road.

emailAddresses.description: Use this main park email address for questions about fees and passes.

operatingHours.description: The Entrance Station is most days in the busy season from May through September, and intermittent hours at other times of year. Hours may vary each day. Call the Fee Manager at 719-378-6352 for hours on the day you plan to visit.
operatingHours.name: Entrance Station
